international.title: Strobe Talbott, Time magazine reporter and deputy US secretary of state, dies aged 80
international.summary: After 21 years at Time, Talbott joined the Clinton administration and later headed the Brookings Institution Strobe Talbott, a former Time magazine reporter who later served as deputy secretary of state under Bill Clinton and then headed the Brookings Institution, died Thursday. He was 80. His son, Devin Talbott, confirmed he died peacefully after a long illness in his East Hampton, New York, home. Continue reading...
